name: Check Windows Component Store Health (DISM)
description: Run DISM’s quick component store check on a schedule and append the result to a log file, so Windows corruption that would break updates or system repair leaves a record before you need it.

parameters.label: Log file path
parameters.help: Where to append the DISM result. DISM needs an elevated session, so run this task with highest privileges. CheckHealth only reads a flag set by earlier damage; it does not scan or repair anything.
